post.title: Designing Gunlands
post.description: Some thoughts on designing systems for Gunlands.

content.paragraph: Gunlands started as a small experiment in making a roguelike shooter focused around building your own weapons.
content.heading: Building the Gun System
content.paragraph: One of the things I really wanted was for the player to feel like they were actually designing their weapon.
This meant breaking the gun down into lots of smaller systems.
